    ∑ N ∈ (F.logWindow y (y ^ α)).filter (fun N => N₀ < F.Smin N), (N : ℝ)⁻¹ =
      F.windowProb α N₀ y * ∑ N ∈ F.logWindow y (y ^ α), (N : ℝ)⁻¹

name: GGMCollatz.Asm.bad_mass_le
statement:
theorem bad_mass_le (F : Family) {c C : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C) {L₀ : ℕ}
    (hseed : ∀ L M : ℕ, L₀ ≤ L → L ≤ M →
      (((Finset.Ico (F.p ^ M) (F.p ^ (M + 1))).filter
          (fun n => ∀ k, F.p ^ L ≤ F.Ct^[k] n)).card : ℝ)
        ≤ C * (F.p : ℝ) ^ M * ((M : ℝ) + 1) * ((L : ℝ) + 1) * Real.exp (-(c * L)))
    {N₀ : ℕ} (hN₀ : 1 ≤ N₀) (hL : L₀ ≤ Nat.log F.p N₀) (lo hi : ℝ) :
    ∑ N ∈ (F.logWindow lo hi).filter (fun N => N₀ < F.Smin N), (N : ℝ)⁻¹ ≤
      C * ((Nat.log F.p ⌊hi⌋₊ : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 * ((Nat.log F.p N₀ : ℝ) + 1) *
        Real.exp (-(c * Nat.log F.p N₀))

name: GGMCollatz.Asm.windowProb_base
statement:
theorem windowProb_base (F : Family) {α : ℝ} (hα : 1 < α) {c C : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C) {L₀ : ℕ}
    (hseed : ∀ L M : ℕ, L₀ ≤ L → L ≤ M →
      (((Finset.Ico (F.p ^ M) (F.p ^ (M + 1))).filter
          (fun n => ∀ k, F.p ^ L ≤ F.Ct^[k] n)).card : ℝ)
        ≤ C * (F.p : ℝ) ^ M * ((M : ℝ) + 1) * ((L : ℝ) + 1) * Real.exp (-(c * L)))
    {N₀ : ℕ} (hN₀ : 1 ≤ N₀) (hL : L₀ ≤ Nat.log F.p N₀)
    (hLw : (yw F α) ^ α ≤ (F.p : ℝ) ^ Nat.log F.p N₀)
    {Λ : ℝ} (hΛ : 0 ≤ Λ) {y : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y) (hyΛ : Real.log y ≤ Λ) :
    F.windowProb α N₀ y ≤ 6 * F.p * C * (α * Λ / Real.log F.p + 1) ^ 2 *
      ((Nat.log F.p N₀ : ℝ) + 1) * Real.exp (-(c * Nat.log F.p N₀))

name: GGMCollatz.Family.backward_bounds
statement:
lemma backward_bounds {Y : ℕ} (hRY : (F.Rb : ℝ) ≤ ((F.q : ℝ) - F.p) * Y)
    {a : ℝ} (ha : (F.Rb : ℝ) = a * F.p * Y) (ha0 : 0 ≤ a) (ha1 : a ≤ 1) :
    ∀ t n, (∀ k < t, Y ≤ F.Ct^[k] n) →
      (F.p : ℝ) ^ t * (F.Ct^[t] n : ℝ) * (1 - a) ^ t ≤ (F.q : ℝ) ^ (F.mulCount t n) * n ∧
      (F.q : ℝ) ^ (F.mulCount t n) * n ≤ (F.p : ℝ) ^ t * (F.Ct^[t] n : ℝ) * (1 + a) ^ t

name: GGMCollatz.Family.card_fiber_le

theorem card_fiber_le {Y : ℕ} (hRY : (F.Rb : ℝ) ≤ ((F.q : ℝ) - F.p) * Y)
    {a : ℝ} (ha : (F.Rb : ℝ) = a * F.p * Y) (ha0 : 0 ≤ a) (ha1 : a ≤ 1) (M t y : ℕ)
    (hta : (t : ℝ) * a ≤ 1 / 4) :
    (((Ico (F.p ^ M) (F.p ^ (M + 1))).filter
        (fun n => F.Ct^[t] n = y ∧ ∀ k < t, Y ≤ F.Ct^[k] n)).card : ℝ)
      ≤ ((t : ℝ) + 1) * (1 + 4 * t * a * (F.p : ℝ) ^ (M + 1))

name: GGMCollatz.Family.iterate_rpow_le
statement:
lemma iterate_rpow_le {θ : ℝ} (hθ0 : 0 ≤ θ) (hθ1 : θ ≤ 1) (n : ℕ) : ∀ m : ℕ,
    (F.Ct^[m] n : ℝ) ^ θ ≤ (∏ k ∈ range m, F.wt θ (F.Ct^[k] n % F.p)) * (n : ℝ) ^ θ
      + ((F.Rb : ℝ) / F.p) ^ θ *
        ∑ i ∈ range m, ∏ k ∈ Ico (i + 1) m, F.wt θ (F.Ct^[k] n % F.p)

name: GGMCollatz.Family.mem_bad
statement: lemma mem_bad {m n : ℕ} : n ∈ F.bad m ↔ (F.p ^ m ≤ n ∧ n < F.p ^ (m + 1)) ∧ F.p ^ m ≤ F.Ct^[m] n

name: GGMCollatz.Family.sum_geom_window_le

    ∑ i ∈ range m, (F.p : ℝ) ^ (i + 1) * ((F.p : ℝ) * ν) ^ (m - 1 - i)

name: GGMCollatz.Family.sum_rpow_le
statement:
lemma sum_rpow_le {θ : ℝ} (hθ0 : 0 ≤ θ) (hθ1 : θ ≤ 1) (m : ℕ) :

      ≤ ((F.p : ℝ) - 1) * (((F.p : ℝ) ^ θ) ^ (m + 1) * (∑ j ∈ range F.p, F.wt θ j) ^ m
        + ((F.Rb : ℝ) / F.p) ^ θ * ∑ i ∈ range m,
            (F.p : ℝ) ^ (i + 1) * (∑ j ∈ range F.p, F.wt θ j) ^ (m - 1 - i))

lemma sum_window_le (θ : ℝ) {m i : ℕ} (hi : i < m) :

      ∃ j, L ≤ j ∧ j ≤ m ∧ ∃ t ≤ m ^ 2,
        F.Ct^[t] n ∈ F.bad j ∧ ∀ k < t, F.p ^ (j + 1) ≤ F.Ct^[k] n

name: GGMCollatz.Family.count_le

theorem count_le {ξ K : ℝ} (hξ0 : 0 < ξ) (hξ1 : ξ < 1) (hK : 0 ≤ K)
    (hbad : ∀ m, ((F.bad m).card : ℝ) ≤ K * (F.p : ℝ) ^ m * ξ ^ m) {L M : ℕ}
    (hL3 : (F.Rb : ℝ) ≤ (F.p : ℝ) ^ L) (hL2 : 4 * (M : ℝ) ^ 2 * F.Rb ≤ (F.p : ℝ) ^ (L + 2))
    [DecidablePred (fun n => ∀ k, F.p ^ L ≤ F.Ct^[k] n)] :
    (((Ico (F.p ^ M) (F.p ^ (M + 1))).filter (fun n => ∀ k, F.p ^ L ≤ F.Ct^[k] n)).card : ℝ)
      ≤ K * (1 + 4 * F.Rb) / (1 - ξ) * ((M : ℝ) + 1) ^ 6 * (F.p : ℝ) ^ M * ξ ^ L

name: GGMCollatz.Asm.err_sum

name: GGMCollatz.Asm.iter_step

    ∀ J : ℕ, F.windowProb α N₀ (x1 ^ (α ^ (J + 1))) ≤ F.windowProb α N₀ (x1 ^ α) +

statement:
theorem uniform (F : Family) {α c Cs Xs : ℝ} (hα : 1 < α) (hc : 0 < c) (hCs : 0 ≤ Cs)

    ∃ K c' : ℝ, 0 < K ∧ 0 < c' ∧ ∀ N₀ : ℕ, 1 ≤ N₀ → ∀ y : ℝ, 0 < y →
      F.windowProb α N₀ y ≤ K * (N₀ : ℝ) ^ (-c')

name: GGMCollatz.Asm.uniform_large
statement:
theorem uniform_large (F : Family) {α c Cs Xs : ℝ} (hα : 1 < α) (hc : 0 < c) (hCs : 0 ≤ Cs)
    (hS : StepHyp F α c Cs Xs) {cB CB : ℝ} (hcB : 0 < cB) (hCB : 0 ≤ CB) {L₀ : ℕ}
    (hseed : ∀ L M : ℕ, L₀ ≤ L → L ≤ M →
      (((Finset.Ico (F.p ^ M) (F.p ^ (M + 1))).filter
          (fun n => ∀ k, F.p ^ L ≤ F.Ct^[k] n)).card : ℝ)
        ≤ CB * (F.p : ℝ) ^ M * ((M : ℝ) + 1) * ((L : ℝ) + 1) * Real.exp (-(cB * L)))
    {c₁ : ℝ} (hc₁ : 0 < c₁) (hc₁a : c₁ ≤ cB / 2) (hc₁b : c₁ ≤ cB * c / 4)
    {N₀ : ℕ} (hN₀ : 1 ≤ N₀) (hL0 : L₀ ≤ Nat.log F.p N₀) (hL1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ Nat.log F.p N₀)
    (hLc : 64 * Real.log F.p / cB ^ 2 ≤ Nat.log F.p N₀) (hLX : 4 * Xs / cB ≤ Nat.log F.p N₀)
    (hLyw : (yw F α) ^ α ≤ Nat.log F.p N₀) (y : ℝ) (hy : 0 < y) :
    F.windowProb α N₀ y ≤ (6 * F.p * CB * (α ^ 3 / Real.log F.p + 1) ^ 2 + Cs / (1 - α ^ (-c))) *
      ((1 + 2 / c₁) * Real.exp (c₁ / 2) * (N₀ : ℝ) ^ (-(c₁ / (2 * Real.log F.p))))

name: GGMCollatz.Asm.window_all
statement:
theorem window_all (F : Family) {α c Cs Xs : ℝ} (hα : 1 < α) (hc : 0 < c) (hCs : 0 ≤ Cs)
    (hS : StepHyp F α c Cs Xs) {cB CB : ℝ} (hCB : 0 ≤ CB) {L₀ : ℕ}
    (hseed : ∀ L M : ℕ, L₀ ≤ L → L ≤ M →
      (((Finset.Ico (F.p ^ M) (F.p ^ (M + 1))).filter
          (fun n => ∀ k, F.p ^ L ≤ F.Ct^[k] n)).card : ℝ)
        ≤ CB * (F.p : ℝ) ^ M * ((M : ℝ) + 1) * ((L : ℝ) + 1) * Real.exp (-(cB * L)))
    {N₀ : ℕ} (hN₀ : 1 ≤ N₀) (hL : L₀ ≤ Nat.log F.p N₀)
    (hLw : (yw F α) ^ α ≤ (F.p : ℝ) ^ Nat.log F.p N₀)
    {v : ℝ} (hv : 0 < v) (hXs : Xs ≤ Real.exp v) (hN₀v : (N₀ : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp v)
    (y : ℝ) (hy : 0 < y) :
    F.windowProb α N₀ y ≤ 6 * F.p * CB * (α * (α ^ 2 * v) / Real.log F.p + 1) ^ 2 *
      ((Nat.log F.p N₀ : ℝ) + 1) * Real.exp (-(cB * Nat.log F.p N₀)) +
      Cs / (1 - α ^ (-c)) * v ^ (-c)

        ∑ N ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 X).filter (fun N => N % F.p ≠ 0 ∧ N₀ < F.Smin N), (N : ℝ)⁻¹

name: GGMCollatz.Asm.logDensity_Np
statement:
theorem logDensity_Np (F : Family) {α : ℝ} (hα : 1 < α) {K c' : ℝ} (hK : 0 ≤ K)
    (hU : ∀ N₀ : ℕ, 1 ≤ N₀ → ∀ y : ℝ, 0 < y → F.windowProb α N₀ y ≤ K * (N₀ : ℝ) ^ (-c'))
    {N₀ : ℕ} (hN₀ : 1 ≤ N₀) {x : ℝ} (hx : 3 ≤ x) :
    ∑ N ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 ⌊x⌋₊).filter (fun N => N % F.p ≠ 0 ∧ N₀ < F.Smin N), (N : ℝ)⁻¹ ≤
      K * (1 / ((α - 1) * Real.log 2) + 1 / Real.log 3 + α ^ 2 / (α - 1)) *

theorem kronW_main {lam μ : ℝ}
    (hk : ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ f : ℝ → ℝ, AntitoneOn f (Set.Icc 0 1) →
      (∀ θ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, 0 ≤ f θ ∧ f θ ≤ 1) →
      ∀ (u : ℝ) (a : ℤ) (ℓ : ℕ), 1 ≤ ℓ →
        |∑ n ∈ Finset.Ico a (a + ℓ), f (Int.fract ((n : ℝ) * lam + u))
            - (ℓ : ℝ) * ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..1, f θ| ≤ C * (ℓ : ℝ) ^ (1 - 1 / μ)) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ f : ℝ → ℝ, AntitoneOn f (Set.Icc 0 1) →
      (∀ θ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, 0 ≤ f θ ∧ f θ ≤ 1) →
      ∀ (u : ℝ) (a : ℤ) (L : ℕ) (w : ℤ → ℝ), (∀ n, 0 ≤ w n) →
      (∀ n, n ∉ Finset.Ico a (a + L) → w n = 0) → ∀ ℓ : ℕ, 1 ≤ ℓ →
        |∑ n ∈ Finset.Ico a (a + L), w n * f (Int.fract ((n : ℝ) * lam + u))
            - (∑ n ∈ Finset.Ico a (a + L), w n) * ∫ θ in (0 : ℝ)..1, f θ|
          ≤ 3 * ℓ * (∑ n ∈ Finset.Ico (a - 1) (a + L), |w (n + 1) - w n|)
            + C * ((∑ n ∈ Finset.Ico a (a + L), w n) * (ℓ : ℝ) ^ (-(1 / μ))
              + (∑ n ∈ Finset.Ico (a - 1) (a + L), |w (n + 1) - w n|) * (ℓ : ℝ) ^ (1 - 1 / μ))

statement:
theorem lclt_log_identity (P n m μ σ2 d u v : ℝ) (hP : 1 < P) (hn : 0 < n) (hm : 0 < m)
    (hμ : μ = P / (P - 1)) (hσ : σ2 = P / (P - 1) ^ 2) (hd : d = (n + m) - μ * n)
    (hu : u = d / (μ * n)) (hv : v = d * (P - 1) / n) :
    stir (n + m) - stir n - stir m + Real.log n - Real.log (n + m) + n * Real.log (P - 1)
        - (n + m) * Real.log P
        - (-(1 / 2) * Real.log (2 * π * σ2 * n) - d ^ 2 / (2 * σ2 * n))
      = μ * n * phi u - (1 / (P - 1)) * n * phi v
          - Real.log (1 + u) / 2 - Real.log (1 + v) / 2

    |μ * n * phi u - (1 / (P - 1)) * n * phi v - Real.log (1 + u) / 2 - Real.log (1 + v) / 2|

statement: theorem dTV_comm (p q : PMF α) : dTV p q = dTV q p

name: PMF.dTV_nonneg
statement: theorem dTV_nonneg (p q : PMF α) : 0 ≤ dTV p q

name: PMF.expect_iid_succ
statement:
theorem expect_iid_succ (p : PMF α) (n : ℕ) (h : (Fin (n + 1) → α) → ℝ)
    (h0 : ∀ v, 0 ≤ h v) (h1 : ∀ v, h v ≤ 1) :
    (p.iid (n + 1)).expect h
      = ∑' a : α, (p a).toReal * (p.iid n).expect fun w => h (Fin.cons a w)

name: PMF.expect_iid_zero
statement:
theorem expect_iid_zero (p : PMF α) (h : (Fin 0 → α) → ℝ) :
    (p.iid 0).expect h = h (fun i => i.elim0)

name: PMF.iid_apply_eq_prod
statement:
theorem iid_apply_eq_prod (p : PMF α) (n : Nat) (v : Fin n → α) :
    p.iid n v = ∏ i, p (v i)

name: PMF.iid_support_coord
statement:
theorem iid_support_coord (p : PMF α) :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (v : Fin n → α), v ∈ (p.iid n).support → ∀ i, v i ∈ p.support

name: PMF.summable_iid_norm_le_one
statement:
theorem summable_iid_norm_le_one (p : PMF α) (k : ℕ) (h : (Fin k → α) → ℂ) (hh : ∀ v, ‖h v‖ ≤ 1) :
    Summable (fun v => ‖((p.iid k) v).toReal * h v‖)

name: PMF.toReal_tsum_mul_ofReal
statement:
theorem toReal_tsum_mul_ofReal (p : PMF α) (f : α → ℝ) (hf : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) :
    (∑' x, p x * ENNReal.ofReal (f x)).toReal = ∑' x, (p x).toReal * f x

name: PMF.tsum_bind_mul
statement:
theorem tsum_bind_mul {β : Type*} (p : PMF α) (f : α → PMF β) (g : β → ℝ≥0∞) :
    ∑' b, (p.bind f) b * g b = ∑' a, p a * ∑' b, f a b * g b

name: PMF.tsum_iid_succ_mul
statement:
theorem tsum_iid_succ_mul (p : PMF α) (n : ℕ) (h : (Fin (n + 1) → α) → ℝ≥0∞) :
    ∑' v : Fin (n + 1) → α, (p.iid (n + 1)) v * h v
      = ∑' a, p a * ∑' w : Fin n → α, (p.iid n) w * h (Fin.cons a w)

name: PMF.tsum_iid_zero_mul
statement:
theorem tsum_iid_zero_mul (p : PMF α) (h : (Fin 0 → α) → ℝ≥0∞) :
    ∑' v : Fin 0 → α, (p.iid 0) v * h v = h (fun i => i.elim0)

name: PMF.tsum_map_mul
statement:
theorem tsum_map_mul {β : Type*} (p : PMF α) (φ : α → β) (g : β → ℝ≥0∞) :
    ∑' b, (p.map φ) b * g b = ∑' a, p a * g (φ a)

name: PMF.tsum_mul_ofReal_le_one
statement:
theorem tsum_mul_ofReal_le_one (p : PMF α) (f : α → ℝ) (hf : ∀ x, f x ≤ 1) :
    ∑' x, p x * ENNReal.ofReal (f x) ≤ 1

name: GGMCollatz.geomP_apply
statement:
theorem geomP_apply {p : ℕ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) (k : ℕ) :
    geomP p k = if k = 0 then 0 else ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞) * ((p : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹) ^ k

name: GGMCollatz.geomP_hasSum
statement:
theorem geomP_hasSum {p : ℕ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) :
    HasSum (fun k : ℕ => if k = 0 then (0 : ℝ≥0∞)
      else ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞) * ((p : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹) ^ k) 1

name: GGMCollatz.geomP_toReal
statement:
theorem geomP_toReal {p : ℕ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) (k : ℕ) :
    (geomP p k).toReal = if k = 0 then 0 else ((p : ℝ) - 1) * ((p : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ k

name: GGMCollatz.geomP_two_apply
statement: theorem geomP_two_apply (k : ℕ) : geomP 2 k = if k = 0 then 0 else ((2 : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹) ^ k

name: GGMCollatz.geomS_apply
statement:
theorem geomS_apply {s : ℝ≥0∞} (hs : 0 < s ∧ s ≤ 1) (k : ℕ) :
    geomS s k = if k = 0 then 0 else s * (1 - s) ^ (k - 1)

name: GGMCollatz.geomS_hasSum
statement:
theorem geomS_hasSum {s : ℝ≥0∞} (hs : 0 < s ∧ s ≤ 1) :
    HasSum (fun k : ℕ => if k = 0 then (0 : ℝ≥0∞) else s * (1 - s) ^ (k - 1)) 1

name: GGMCollatz.geomS_summable_toReal
statement: theorem geomS_summable_toReal (s : ℝ≥0∞) : Summable fun k : ℕ => (geomS s k).toReal

name: GGMCollatz.geomS_tail
statement:
theorem geomS_tail {s : ℝ≥0∞} (hs : 0 < s ∧ s ≤ 1) (t : ℕ) :
    ∑' k : ℕ, (if t < k then (geomS s k).toReal else 0) = (1 - s.toReal) ^ t

name: GGMCollatz.geomS_toReal
statement:
theorem geomS_toReal {s : ℝ≥0∞} (hs : 0 < s ∧ s ≤ 1) (k : ℕ) :
    (geomS s k).toReal = if k = 0 then 0 else s.toReal * (1 - s.toReal) ^ (k - 1)

name: GGMCollatz.geomS_tsum_toReal
statement: theorem geomS_tsum_toReal (s : ℝ≥0∞) : ∑' k : ℕ, (geomS s k).toReal = 1

name: GGMCollatz.holdGeom_prob
statement: theorem holdGeom_prob {p : ℕ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) : 0 < pascalP p 3 ∧ pascalP p 3 ≤ 1

name: GGMCollatz.iid_geomP_apply_eq_zero_of_not_pos
statement:
theorem iid_geomP_apply_eq_zero_of_not_pos {p : ℕ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) (n : ℕ) (a : Fin n → ℕ)
    (ha : ¬ ∀ i, 1 ≤ a i) : (PMF.iid (geomP p) n) a = 0

name: GGMCollatz.iid_geomP_apply_of_pos
statement:
theorem iid_geomP_apply_of_pos {p : ℕ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) (n : ℕ) (a : Fin n → ℕ)
    (ha : ∀ i, 1 ≤ a i) :
    (PMF.iid (geomP p) n) a = ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞) ^ n * ((p : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹) ^ (∑ i, a i)

name: GGMCollatz.iid_geomP_sum_zero
statement:
theorem iid_geomP_sum_zero {p : ℕ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) (w : Fin n → ℕ)
    (hw : ∑ i, w i = 0) : (PMF.iid (geomP p) n) w = 0

name: GGMCollatz.iid_map_comp
statement:
theorem iid_map_comp {α β : Type*} (μ : PMF α) (f : α → β) :
    ∀ n : ℕ, (μ.iid n).map (fun v => f ∘ v) = (μ.map f).iid n

name: GGMCollatz.iid_stepLaw_apply
statement:
theorem iid_stepLaw_apply (p n : ℕ) (v : Fin n → ℕ × ℕ) :
    ((stepLaw p).iid n) v = ∏ i, geomP p (v i).1 * unifDigit p (v i).2

name: GGMCollatz.iid_stepLaw_map_fst
statement:
theorem iid_stepLaw_map_fst (p n : ℕ) :
    ((stepLaw p).iid n).map (fun v => Prod.fst ∘ v) = (geomP p).iid n

name: GGMCollatz.iid_stepLaw_map_snd
statement:
theorem iid_stepLaw_map_snd (p n : ℕ) :
    ((stepLaw p).iid n).map (fun v => Prod.snd ∘ v) = (unifDigit p).iid n

name: GGMCollatz.map_sum_apply
statement:
theorem map_sum_apply (μ : PMF ℕ) (n L : ℕ) :
    ((μ.iid n).map fun v => ∑ i, v i) L
      = ∑' v : Fin n → ℕ, (μ.iid n) v * (if L = ∑ i, v i then 1 else 0)

name: GGMCollatz.natCast_inv_ne_top
statement: theorem natCast_inv_ne_top {p : ℕ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) : ((p : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹) ≠ ⊤

name: GGMCollatz.natCast_inv_ne_zero
statement: theorem natCast_inv_ne_zero (p : ℕ) : ((p : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹) ≠ 0

name: GGMCollatz.natCast_sub_one_ne_zero
statement: theorem natCast_sub_one_ne_zero {p : ℕ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) : ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞) ≠ 0

name: GGMCollatz.negBinomial_apply
statement:
theorem negBinomial_apply {p : ℕ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) (n L : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hL : 1 ≤ L) :
    ((PMF.iid (geomP p) n).map (fun v => ∑ i, v i)) L
      = (L - 1).choose (n - 1) * ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞) ^ n * ((p : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹) ^ L

name: GGMCollatz.one_sub_inv_natCast
statement:
theorem one_sub_inv_natCast {p : ℕ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    (1 : ℝ≥0∞) - (p : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ = ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞) * (p : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹

name: GGMCollatz.pascalNe3P_apply
statement:
theorem pascalNe3P_apply {p : ℕ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) (b : ℕ) :
    pascalNe3P p b = if b = 3 then 0 else (1 - pascalP p 3)⁻¹ * pascalP p b

name: GGMCollatz.pascalP_apply
statement:
theorem pascalP_apply {p : ℕ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) (b : ℕ) :
    pascalP p b = if b < 2 then 0
      else ((b - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞) * ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞) ^ 2 * ((p : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹) ^ b

name: GGMCollatz.pascalP_three
statement:
theorem pascalP_three {p : ℕ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) :
    pascalP p 3 = 2 * ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞) ^ 2 * ((p : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹) ^ 3

name: GGMCollatz.pascalP_three_pos
statement: theorem pascalP_three_pos {p : ℕ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) : 0 < pascalP p 3

name: GGMCollatz.pascalP_two_pos
statement: theorem pascalP_two_pos {p : ℕ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) : 0 < pascalP p 2

name: GGMCollatz.pascal_eq_map_iid
statement:
theorem pascal_eq_map_iid (p : ℕ) :
    pascalP p = (PMF.iid (geomP p) 2).map (fun v => v 0 + v 1)

name: GGMCollatz.stepLaw_apply
statement: theorem stepLaw_apply (p a d : ℕ) : stepLaw p (a, d) = geomP p a * unifDigit p d

name: GGMCollatz.stepLaw_map_fst
statement: theorem stepLaw_map_fst (p : ℕ) : (stepLaw p).map Prod.fst = geomP p

name: GGMCollatz.stepLaw_map_snd
statement: theorem stepLaw_map_snd (p : ℕ) : (stepLaw p).map Prod.snd = unifDigit p

name: GGMCollatz.sum_Ico_choose_shift
statement:
theorem sum_Ico_choose_shift (m L : ℕ) :
    ∑ a ∈ Finset.Ico 1 L, (L - a - 1).choose m = (L - 1).choose (m + 1)

name: GGMCollatz.sum_range_choose_col
statement:
theorem sum_range_choose_col (K m : ℕ) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range K, j.choose m = K.choose (m + 1)

name: GGMCollatz.tsum_ite_zero_eq_succ
statement:
theorem tsum_ite_zero_eq_succ (g : ℕ → ℝ≥0∞) :
    ∑' a : ℕ, (if a = 0 then 0 else g a) = ∑' n : ℕ, g (n + 1)

name: GGMCollatz.tsum_pascalP_ne_three
statement:
theorem tsum_pascalP_ne_three (p : ℕ) :
    ∑' b, ({b | b ≠ 3} : Set ℕ).indicator (pascalP p) b = 1 - pascalP p 3

name: GGMCollatz.unifDigit_apply
statement:
theorem unifDigit_apply {p : ℕ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) (d : ℕ) :
    unifDigit p d = if 0 < d ∧ d < p then ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ else 0

name: GGMCollatz.Gweight_le_two
statement: theorem Gweight_le_two (t x : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) : Gweight t x ≤ 2

name: GGMCollatz.Gweight_nonneg
statement: theorem Gweight_nonneg (t x : ℝ) : 0 ≤ Gweight t x

name: GGMCollatz.Gweight_pos
statement: theorem Gweight_pos (t x : ℝ) : 0 < Gweight t x

name: GGMCollatz.iidSum_add
statement:
theorem iidSum_add (p : PMF M) (k n : ℕ) :
    iidSum p (k + n) = (iidSum p k).bind fun s => (iidSum p n).map (s + ·)

name: GGMCollatz.iidSum_geomP_apply
statement:
theorem iidSum_geomP_apply {p : ℕ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) (n L : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hL : 1 ≤ L) :
    (iidSum (geomP p) n) L
      = (L - 1).choose (n - 1) * ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞) ^ n * ((p : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹) ^ L

name: GGMCollatz.iidSum_iidSum
statement:
theorem iidSum_iidSum (p : PMF M) (k n : ℕ) :
    iidSum (iidSum p k) n = iidSum p (n * k)

name: GGMCollatz.iidSum_map
statement:
theorem iidSum_map (p : PMF M) {M' : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M'] (φ : M → M')
    (hφ0 : φ 0 = 0) (hφ : ∀ a b, φ (a + b) = φ a + φ b) (n : ℕ) :
    (iidSum p n).map φ = iidSum (p.map φ) n

name: GGMCollatz.iidSum_pascalP_apply
statement:
theorem iidSum_pascalP_apply {p : ℕ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) (n L : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hL : 1 ≤ L) :
    (iidSum (pascalP p) n) L
      = (L - 1).choose (2 * n - 1) * ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (2 * n) * ((p : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹) ^ L

name: GGMCollatz.iidSum_succ
statement:
theorem iidSum_succ (p : PMF M) (n : ℕ) :
    iidSum p (n + 1) = p.bind fun a => (iidSum p n).map (a + ·)

name: GGMCollatz.iidSum_zero
statement: theorem iidSum_zero (p : PMF M) : iidSum p 0 = PMF.pure 0

name: GGMCollatz.pascalP_eq_iidSum
statement: theorem pascalP_eq_iidSum (p : ℕ) : pascalP p = iidSum (geomP p) 2

name: GGMCollatz.apply_toReal_le_sum_norm_charFn
statement:
theorem apply_toReal_le_sum_norm_charFn (r : PMF (ZMod N × ZMod N))
    (x : ZMod N × ZMod N) :
    (r x).toReal ≤ ((N : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹ * ∑ ξ, ‖charFn r ξ‖

name: GGMCollatz.charFn_bind
statement:
theorem charFn_bind (p : PMF (ZMod N × ZMod N)) (f : ZMod N × ZMod N → PMF (ZMod N × ZMod N))
    (ξ : ZMod N × ZMod N) :
    charFn (p.bind f) ξ = ∑ a, ((p a).toReal : ℂ) * charFn (f a) ξ

name: GGMCollatz.charFn_iidSum
statement:
theorem charFn_iidSum (r : PMF (ZMod N × ZMod N)) (n : ℕ) (ξ : ZMod N × ZMod N) :
    charFn (iidSum r n) ξ = (charFn r ξ) ^ n

name: GGMCollatz.charFn_inversion
statement:
theorem charFn_inversion (r : PMF (ZMod N × ZMod N)) (x : ZMod N × ZMod N) :
    ((r x).toReal : ℂ)
      = ((N : ℂ) ^ 2)⁻¹ * ∑ ξ, charFn r ξ * pairChar ξ (-x)

name: GGMCollatz.charFn_map_add
statement:
theorem charFn_map_add (q : PMF (ZMod N × ZMod N)) (a ξ : ZMod N × ZMod N) :
    charFn (q.map (a + ·)) ξ = pairChar ξ a * charFn q ξ

name: GGMCollatz.charFn_normSq_pair_bound
statement:
theorem charFn_normSq_pair_bound (r : PMF (ZMod N × ZMod N))
    (ξ y₀ y₁ : ZMod N × ZMod N) (h01 : y₀ ≠ y₁) :
    2 * (r y₀).toReal * (r y₁).toReal * (1 - (pairChar ξ (y₀ - y₁)).re)
      ≤ 1 - ‖charFn r ξ‖ ^ 2

name: GGMCollatz.charFn_pure_zero
statement:
theorem charFn_pure_zero (ξ : ZMod N × ZMod N) :
    charFn (PMF.pure 0) ξ = 1

name: GGMCollatz.exists_natAbs_eq_nd
statement:
theorem exists_natAbs_eq_nd (j : ZMod N) :
    ∃ x : ℤ, (x : ZMod N) = j ∧ x.natAbs = nd j

name: GGMCollatz.iidSum_apply_toReal_le
statement:
theorem iidSum_apply_toReal_le (r : PMF (ZMod N × ZMod N)) (n : ℕ)
    (x : ZMod N × ZMod N) :
    ((iidSum r n) x).toReal ≤ ((N : ℝ) ^ 2)⁻¹ * ∑ ξ, ‖charFn r ξ‖ ^ n

name: GGMCollatz.nd_cast
statement:
theorem nd_cast (j : ZMod N) :
    ((nd j : ℕ) : ℝ) = min (j.val : ℝ) ((N : ℝ) - j.val)

name: GGMCollatz.nd_le_natAbs
statement: theorem nd_le_natAbs (x : ℤ) : nd ((x : ZMod N)) ≤ x.natAbs

name: GGMCollatz.nd_sub_le
statement: theorem nd_sub_le (a b : ZMod N) : nd (a - b) ≤ nd a + nd b

name: GGMCollatz.one_sub_exp_neg_inv_le
statement:
theorem one_sub_exp_neg_inv_le {a : ℝ} (h0 : 0 < a) (h1 : a ≤ 1) :
    (1 - Real.exp (-a))⁻¹ ≤ 2 / a

name: GGMCollatz.one_sub_re_stdAddChar_ge
statement:
theorem one_sub_re_stdAddChar_ge (j : ZMod N) :
    8 * ((min (j.val : ℝ) ((N : ℝ) - j.val)) / N) ^ 2
      ≤ 1 - (ZMod.stdAddChar j).re

name: GGMCollatz.one_sub_re_stdAddChar_ge'
statement:
theorem one_sub_re_stdAddChar_ge' (j : ZMod N) :
    8 * ((nd j : ℝ) / N) ^ 2 ≤ 1 - (ZMod.stdAddChar j).re

name: GGMCollatz.pairChar_add_right
statement:
theorem pairChar_add_right (ξ y z : ZMod N × ZMod N) :
    pairChar ξ (y + z) = pairChar ξ y * pairChar ξ z

name: GGMCollatz.pairChar_conj
statement:
theorem pairChar_conj (ξ y : ZMod N × ZMod N) :
    (starRingEnd ℂ) (pairChar ξ y) = pairChar ξ (-y)

name: GGMCollatz.pairChar_mul_conj
statement:
theorem pairChar_mul_conj (ξ y y' : ZMod N × ZMod N) :
    pairChar ξ y * (starRingEnd ℂ) (pairChar ξ y') = pairChar ξ (y - y')

name: GGMCollatz.pairChar_norm
statement: theorem pairChar_norm (ξ y : ZMod N × ZMod N) : ‖pairChar ξ y‖ = 1

name: GGMCollatz.pairChar_zero_right
statement: theorem pairChar_zero_right (ξ : ZMod N × ZMod N) : pairChar ξ 0 = 1

name: GGMCollatz.pow_le_exp_of_sq_le_one_sub
statement:
theorem pow_le_exp_of_sq_le_one_sub {x D : ℝ} (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n)
    (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hD : 0 ≤ D) (h : x ^ 2 ≤ 1 - D) :
    x ^ n ≤ Real.exp (-(n : ℝ) * D / 4)

name: GGMCollatz.sum_exp_neg_mul_le
statement:
theorem sum_exp_neg_mul_le {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (M : ℕ) :
    ∑ m ∈ Finset.range M, Real.exp (-(a * m)) ≤ (1 - Real.exp (-a))⁻¹

name: GGMCollatz.sum_exp_neg_nd_sq_le
statement:
theorem sum_exp_neg_nd_sq_le {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) :
    ∑ t : ZMod N, Real.exp (-(a * ((nd t : ℝ)) ^ 2))
      ≤ 2 * (1 - Real.exp (-a))⁻¹

name: GGMCollatz.sum_map_mul_complex
statement:
theorem sum_map_mul_complex {α β : Type*} [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β]
    (q : PMF α) (φ : α → β) (g : β → ℂ) :
    ∑ y, (((q.map φ) y).toReal : ℂ) * g y = ∑ z, ((q z).toReal : ℂ) * g (φ z)

name: GGMCollatz.sum_pairChar
statement:
theorem sum_pairChar (z : ZMod N × ZMod N) :
    ∑ ξ : ZMod N × ZMod N, pairChar ξ z = if z = 0 then ((N : ℂ) ^ 2) else 0

name: GGMCollatz.sum_stdAddChar_mul
statement:
theorem sum_stdAddChar_mul (t : ZMod N) :
    ∑ i : ZMod N, ZMod.stdAddChar (t * i) = if t = 0 then (N : ℂ) else 0

name: GGMCollatz.sum_toReal_eq_one
statement:
theorem sum_toReal_eq_one {α : Type*} [Fintype α] (r : PMF α) :
    ∑ y, (r y).toReal = 1

name: GGMCollatz.sum_zmod_eq_sum_range
statement:
theorem sum_zmod_eq_sum_range (f : ℕ → ℝ) :
    ∑ t : ZMod N, f t.val = ∑ m ∈ Finset.range N, f m

name: GGMCollatz.toReal_bind_apply
statement:
theorem toReal_bind_apply {α β : Type*} [Fintype α] (p : PMF α) (f : α → PMF β)
    (y : β) : ((p.bind f) y).toReal = ∑ a, (p a).toReal * ((f a) y).toReal

name: GGMCollatz.charFn_embMod_decay_of_adjacent_atoms
statement:
theorem charFn_embMod_decay_of_adjacent_atoms (hN : 4 ≤ N)
    (r : PMF (ZMod N × ZMod N)) {μ : ℝ} (hμ : 0 ≤ μ) (a : ℕ)
    (hma : μ ≤ (r (embMod N a)).toReal) (hmb : μ ≤ (r (embMod N (a + 1))).toReal)
    (j : ZMod N) :
    ‖charFn r (j, 0)‖ ^ 2 ≤ 1 - 16 * μ ^ 2 * ((nd j : ℝ) / N) ^ 2

name: GGMCollatz.charFn_map_embMod_snd
statement:
theorem charFn_map_embMod_snd (p : PMF ℕ) (ξ : ZMod N × ZMod N) :
    charFn (p.map (embMod N)) ξ = charFn (p.map (embMod N)) (ξ.1, 0)

name: GGMCollatz.embMod_add
statement: theorem embMod_add (a b : ℕ) : embMod N (a + b) = embMod N a + embMod N b

name: GGMCollatz.embMod_zero
statement: theorem embMod_zero : embMod N 0 = 0

name: GGMCollatz.iidSum_nat_apply_le_center_of_decay
statement:
theorem iidSum_nat_apply_le_center_of_decay (p : PMF ℕ) {c : ℝ} (hc : 1 ≤ c)
    (hdec : ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N], 4 ≤ N → ∀ j : ZMod N,
      ‖charFn (p.map (embMod N)) (j, 0)‖ ^ 2 ≤ 1 - ((nd j : ℝ) / N) ^ 2 / c)
    (n : ℕ) (L : ℕ) :
    ((iidSum p n) L).toReal ≤ 32 * c / Real.sqrt (1 + (n : ℝ))

name: GGMCollatz.iidSum_nat_apply_toReal_le
statement:
theorem iidSum_nat_apply_toReal_le (p : PMF ℕ) (n : ℕ) (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (L : ℕ) :
    ((iidSum p n) L).toReal
      ≤ ((N : ℝ))⁻¹ * ∑ j : ZMod N, ‖charFn (p.map (embMod N)) (j, 0)‖ ^ n

name: GGMCollatz.map_embMod_apply_ne
statement:
theorem map_embMod_apply_ne (p : PMF ℕ) {y : ZMod N × ZMod N} (hy : y.2 ≠ 0) :

name: GGMCollatz.ennreal_mul_le_sq_add_sq_div_two
statement:
theorem ennreal_mul_le_sq_add_sq_div_two (x y : ℝ≥0∞) :
    x * y ≤ (x ^ 2 + y ^ 2) / 2

name: GGMCollatz.iidSum_apply_eq_tilt
statement:
theorem iidSum_apply_eq_tilt [AddCommMonoid M] (p : PMF M) {w : M → ℝ≥0∞} (hw0 : w 0 = 1)
    (hwadd : ∀ a b, w (a + b) = w a * w b)
    (hZ0 : tiltZ p w ≠ 0) (hZt : tiltZ p w ≠ ∞) (n : ℕ) (v : M)
    (hwv0 : w v ≠ 0) (hwvt : w v ≠ ∞) :
    (iidSum p n) v
      = (iidSum (tilt p w hZ0 hZt) n) v * (tiltZ p w) ^ n * (w v)⁻¹

name: GGMCollatz.iidSum_tilt_apply
statement:
theorem iidSum_tilt_apply [AddCommMonoid M] (p : PMF M) {w : M → ℝ≥0∞} (hw0 : w 0 = 1)
    (hwadd : ∀ a b, w (a + b) = w a * w b)
    (hZ0 : tiltZ p w ≠ 0) (hZt : tiltZ p w ≠ ∞) (n : ℕ) (v : M) :
    (iidSum (tilt p w hZ0 hZt) n) v * (tiltZ p w) ^ n = (iidSum p n) v * w v

name: GGMCollatz.tiltZ_iidSum
statement:
theorem tiltZ_iidSum [AddCommMonoid M] (p : PMF M) {w : M → ℝ≥0∞} (hw0 : w 0 = 1)
    (hwadd : ∀ a b, w (a + b) = w a * w b)
    (hZ0 : tiltZ p w ≠ 0) (hZt : tiltZ p w ≠ ∞) (n : ℕ) :
    tiltZ (iidSum p n) w = (tiltZ p w) ^ n

name: GGMCollatz.tiltZ_map
statement:
theorem tiltZ_map {M' : Type*} (p : PMF M) (φ : M → M') (w : M' → ℝ≥0∞) :
    tiltZ (p.map φ) w = tiltZ p (w ∘ φ)

name: GGMCollatz.tilt_apply
statement:
theorem tilt_apply (p : PMF M) (w : M → ℝ≥0∞) (hZ0 : tiltZ p w ≠ 0)
    (hZt : tiltZ p w ≠ ∞) (d : M) :
    tilt p w hZ0 hZt d = p d * w d * (tiltZ p w)⁻¹

name: GGMCollatz.tsum_mul_mul_sq_le
statement:
theorem tsum_mul_mul_sq_le {ι : Type*} (p u v : ι → ℝ≥0∞) :
    (∑' d, p d * (u d * v d)) ^ 2
      ≤ (∑' d, p d * (u d) ^ 2) * (∑' d, p d * (v d) ^ 2)

name: GGMCollatz.expW2_add
statement:
theorem expW2_add (l1 l2 : ℝ) (a b : ℕ × ℤ) :
    expW2 l1 l2 (a + b) = expW2 l1 l2 a * expW2 l1 l2 b

name: GGMCollatz.expW2_eq_mul
statement:
theorem expW2_eq_mul (l1 l2 : ℝ) (d : ℕ × ℤ) :
    expW2 l1 l2 d = expW2 l1 0 d * expW2 0 l2 d

name: GGMCollatz.expW2_sq
statement:
theorem expW2_sq (l1 l2 : ℝ) (d : ℕ × ℤ) :
    expW2 l1 l2 d ^ 2 = expW2 (2 * l1) (2 * l2) d

name: GGMCollatz.expW2_zero
statement: theorem expW2_zero (l1 l2 : ℝ) : expW2 l1 l2 0 = 1

name: GGMCollatz.expW_add
statement:
theorem expW_add (lam : ℝ) (a b : ℕ) :
    expW lam (a + b) = expW lam a * expW lam b

name: GGMCollatz.expW_zero
statement: theorem expW_zero (lam : ℝ) : expW lam 0 = 1

name: GGMCollatz.exp_le_inv_one_sub
statement:
theorem exp_le_inv_one_sub {x : ℝ} (h1 : x < 1) :
    Real.exp x ≤ (1 - x)⁻¹

name: GGMCollatz.exp_le_one_add_add_two_sq
statement:
theorem exp_le_one_add_add_two_sq {u : ℝ} (hu : u ≤ 1 / 2) :
    Real.exp u ≤ 1 + u + 2 * u ^ 2

name: GGMCollatz.frac_closed_le
statement:
theorem frac_closed_le {a a' r r' : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (haa : a ≤ a') (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (hrr : r ≤ r') (h1 : r' < 1) :
    ENNReal.ofReal a * (1 - ENNReal.ofReal r)⁻¹
      ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (a' / (1 - r'))

name: GGMCollatz.geom_closed_le
statement:
theorem geom_closed_le {q q' : ℝ} (h0 : 0 ≤ q) (hqq : q ≤ q') (h1 : q' < 1) :
    ENNReal.ofReal q * (1 - ENNReal.ofReal q)⁻¹
      ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (q' / (1 - q'))

name: GGMCollatz.tiltZ_expW2_sq_le
statement:
theorem tiltZ_expW2_sq_le (p : PMF (ℕ × ℤ)) (l1 l2 : ℝ) :
    tiltZ p (expW2 l1 l2) ^ 2
      ≤ tiltZ p (expW2 (2 * l1) 0) * tiltZ p (expW2 0 (2 * l2))

name: GGMCollatz.tiltZ_expW_ne_zero
statement: theorem tiltZ_expW_ne_zero (p : PMF ℕ) (lam : ℝ) : tiltZ p (expW lam) ≠ 0

name: GGMCollatz.tiltZ_geomP
statement:
theorem tiltZ_geomP {p : ℕ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) (lam : ℝ) :
    tiltZ (geomP p) (expW lam)
      = ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞) * (ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp lam / p)
          * (1 - ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp lam / p))⁻¹)

name: GGMCollatz.tiltZ_geomP_frac
statement:
theorem tiltZ_geomP_frac {p : ℕ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) (lam : ℝ) :
    tiltZ (geomP p) (expW lam)
      = ENNReal.ofReal (((p : ℝ) - 1) * Real.exp lam / p)
          * (1 - ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp lam / p))⁻¹

name: GGMCollatz.tiltZ_geomP_ne_top
statement:
theorem tiltZ_geomP_ne_top {p : ℕ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) {lam : ℝ} (hlam : Real.exp lam < p) :
    tiltZ (geomP p) (expW lam) ≠ ∞

name: GGMCollatz.tiltZ_geomP_ne_zero
statement: theorem tiltZ_geomP_ne_zero {p : ℕ} (lam : ℝ) : tiltZ (geomP p) (expW lam) ≠ 0

name: GGMCollatz.tiltZ_pascalP
statement:
theorem tiltZ_pascalP {p : ℕ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) {lam : ℝ} (hlam : Real.exp lam < p) :
    tiltZ (pascalP p) (expW lam) = (tiltZ (geomP p) (expW lam)) ^ 2

name: GGMCollatz.C_geomTail_pos
statement: theorem C_geomTail_pos : 0 < C_geomTail

name: GGMCollatz.Gweight_abs
statement: theorem Gweight_abs (t x : ℝ) : Gweight t |x| = Gweight t x

name: GGMCollatz.c_geomTail_pos
statement: theorem c_geomTail_pos : 0 < c_geomTail

name: GGMCollatz.chernoff_clip_le
statement:
theorem chernoff_clip_le {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) (dev : ℝ) :
    ∃ lam : ℝ, -(1 / 200) ≤ lam ∧ lam ≤ 1 / 200 ∧
      1000 * (n : ℝ) * lam ^ 2 - lam * dev
        ≤ -min (dev ^ 2 / (4000 * n)) (|dev| / 400)

name: GGMCollatz.chernoff_clip_le_nonneg
statement:
theorem chernoff_clip_le_nonneg {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) {dev : ℝ} (hdev : 0 ≤ dev) :
    ∃ mu : ℝ, 0 ≤ mu ∧ mu ≤ 1 / 200 ∧
      1000 * (n : ℝ) * mu ^ 2 - mu * dev
        ≤ -min (dev ^ 2 / (4000 * n)) (dev / 400)

name: GGMCollatz.exp_neg_min_le_Gweight
statement:
theorem exp_neg_min_le_Gweight {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    Real.exp (-min (x ^ 2 / (4000 * n)) (x / 400)) ≤ Gweight (1 + n) (1 / 400 * x)

name: GGMCollatz.geomP_local_bound
statement:
theorem geomP_local_bound {p : ℕ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) :
    ∃ c > (0 : ℝ), ∃ C > (0 : ℝ), ∀ (n L : ℕ),
      ((iidSum (geomP p) n) L).toReal
        ≤ C / Real.sqrt (1 + n) * Gweight (1 + n) (c * ((L : ℝ) - muP p * n))

name: GGMCollatz.geomP_tail_bound
statement:
theorem geomP_tail_bound {p : ℕ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) :
    ∃ c > (0 : ℝ), ∃ C > (0 : ℝ), ∀ (n : ℕ) (lam : ℝ), 0 ≤ lam →
      (∑' L : ℕ, if lam ≤ |(L : ℝ) - muP p * n| then ((iidSum (geomP p) n) L).toReal else 0)
        ≤ C * Gweight (1 + n) (c * lam)

name: GGMCollatz.geomP_tail_bound_atC
statement:
theorem geomP_tail_bound_atC {p : ℕ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (lam : ℝ), 0 ≤ lam →
      (∑' L : ℕ, if lam ≤ |(L : ℝ) - muP p * n| then ((iidSum (geomP p) n) L).toReal else 0)
        ≤ C_geomTail * Gweight (1 + n) (c_geomTail * lam)

name: GGMCollatz.geomP_toReal_one_two_ge
statement:
theorem geomP_toReal_one_two_ge {p : ℕ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) :
    ((p : ℝ) - 1) / (p : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ (geomP p 1).toReal ∧
      ((p : ℝ) - 1) / (p : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ (geomP p 2).toReal

name: GGMCollatz.iidSum_nat_halfspace_le
statement:
theorem iidSum_nat_halfspace_le (p : PMF ℕ) {t : ℝ}
    (hZt : tiltZ p (expW t) ≠ ∞) (n : ℕ)
    (cond : ℕ → Prop) [DecidablePred cond] (a : ℝ)
    (hcond : ∀ L : ℕ, cond L → a ≤ t * L) :
    (∑' L : ℕ, if cond L then (iidSum p n) L else 0)
      ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-a)) * tiltZ p (expW t) ^ n

name: GGMCollatz.iidSum_nat_local_of_quad
statement:
theorem iidSum_nat_local_of_quad (p : PMF ℕ) (m : ℝ) (hm0 : 0 ≤ m) (hm4 : m ≤ 4)
    (hquad : ∀ lam : ℝ, -(1 / 200) ≤ lam → lam ≤ 1 / 200 →
      tiltZ p (expW lam) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (1 + m * lam + 1000 * lam ^ 2))
    (a : ℕ) (ha3 : a + 1 ≤ 3) (δ : ℝ) (hδ0 : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1 / 2)
    (hpa : δ ≤ (p a).toReal) (hpb : δ ≤ (p (a + 1)).toReal)
    (n L : ℕ) :
    ((iidSum p n) L).toReal
      ≤ 8 / δ ^ 2 / Real.sqrt (1 + n) * Gweight (1 + n) (1 / 400 * ((L : ℝ) - m * n))

name: GGMCollatz.iidSum_nat_tail_of_quad
statement:
theorem iidSum_nat_tail_of_quad (p : PMF ℕ) (m : ℝ)
    (hquad : ∀ lam : ℝ, -(1 / 200) ≤ lam → lam ≤ 1 / 200 →
      tiltZ p (expW lam) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (1 + m * lam + 1000 * lam ^ 2))
    (n : ℕ) (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 ≤ lam) :
    (∑' L : ℕ, if lam ≤ |(L : ℝ) - m * n| then ((iidSum p n) L).toReal else 0)
      ≤ 2 * Gweight (1 + n) (1 / 400 * lam)

name: GGMCollatz.muP_le_two
statement: theorem muP_le_two {p : ℕ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) : muP p ≤ 2

name: GGMCollatz.muP_pos
statement: theorem muP_pos {p : ℕ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) : 0 < muP p

name: GGMCollatz.one_lt_muP
statement: theorem one_lt_muP {p : ℕ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) : 1 < muP p

name: GGMCollatz.pascalP_local_bound
statement:
theorem pascalP_local_bound {p : ℕ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) :
    ∃ c > (0 : ℝ), ∃ C > (0 : ℝ), ∀ (n L : ℕ),

name: GGMCollatz.pascalP_tail_bound
statement:

    ∃ c > (0 : ℝ), ∃ C > (0 : ℝ), ∀ (n : ℕ) (lam : ℝ), 0 ≤ lam →

name: GGMCollatz.pascalP_toReal_two_three_ge
statement:

    ((p : ℝ) - 1) ^ 2 / (p : ℝ) ^ 3 ≤ (pascalP p 2).toReal ∧

name: GGMCollatz.tiltZ_geomP_le_quad
statement:
theorem tiltZ_geomP_le_quad {p : ℕ} (hp : 2 ≤ p) {lam : ℝ} (hlo : -(1 / 200) ≤ lam)

name: GGMCollatz.tiltZ_pascalP_le_quad

name: GGMCollatz.HL.charFn_decay_of_atoms
statement:
theorem charFn_decay_of_atoms {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (hN : 4 ≤ N)
    (r : PMF (ZMod N × ZMod N)) {μ : ℝ} (hμ : 0 ≤ μ)
    (hm13 : μ ≤ (r (modPair N (1, 3))).toReal)
    (hm25 : μ ≤ (r (modPair N (2, 5))).toReal)
    (hm27 : μ ≤ (r (modPair N (2, 7))).toReal)
    (hm28 : μ ≤ (r (modPair N (2, 8))).toReal)
    (ξ : ZMod N × ZMod N) :
    ‖charFn r ξ‖ ^ 2
      ≤ 1 - 2 * μ ^ 2 * (((nd ξ.1 : ℝ) / N) ^ 2 + ((nd ξ.2 : ℝ) / N) ^ 2)

name: GGMCollatz.HL.iidSum_apply_le_center_of_decay
statement:
theorem iidSum_apply_le_center_of_decay (p : PMF (ℕ × ℤ)) {c : ℝ} (hc : 1 ≤ c)
    (hdec : ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N], 4 ≤ N → ∀ ξ : ZMod N × ZMod N,
      ‖charFn (p.map (modPair N)) ξ‖ ^ 2
        ≤ 1 - (((nd ξ.1 : ℝ) / N) ^ 2 + ((nd ξ.2 : ℝ) / N) ^ 2) / c)
    (n : ℕ) (v : ℕ × ℤ) :
    ((iidSum p n) v).toReal ≤ (32 * c) ^ 2 / (1 + (n : ℝ))

name: GGMCollatz.HL.pair_transfer
statement:
theorem pair_transfer {X m0 m1 c0 c1 R u : ℝ} (hm0 : c0 ≤ m0) (hm1 : c1 ≤ m1)
    (hc0 : 0 ≤ c0) (hc1 : 0 ≤ c1) (hJ : 8 * u ^ 2 ≤ 1 - R)
    (hb : 2 * m0 * m1 * (1 - R) ≤ X) : 2 * c0 * c1 * (8 * u ^ 2) ≤ X
